narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Myth Debunking -> Historical Evidence -> Scientific Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To debunk the popular myth that it takes exactly 21 days to form a new habit by tracing its origin to an observation by plastic surgeon Maxwell Maltz, while suggesting that identity change is a more effective method.
